payload.title: Implement automatic versioned Markdown references and bounded document retrieval
payload.description: Write plans once as Markdown; task-bound write hooks save compact path/role/hash references; expose relevant bounded document sections through DIP tools and dashboard. Structured ownership/status/verification remain canonical DIP. Handle untrusted paths, changes, missing documents and ambiguous attribution without model calls.
acceptance: Supported successful agent Markdown writes with trusted task context create versioned references without copying prose.
MCP and CLI can link/list/read selected sections with limits and currentness evidence; unknown attribution does not guess task ownership.
References persist and merge in event ledger; dashboard shows linked documents; current content changes or deletion are explicit.
Tests cover successful/failing/ambiguous hooks, stale/renamed/missing/unsafe paths, bounded section retrieval and unchanged verification authority.
